verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs describe the Oz CLI as the tool for running and managing cloud agents "from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline" without the desktop app. API keys let it authenticate without human interaction on CI pipelines, headless servers, containers and VMs, and agent profiles control permissions for CLI runs. Triggers, schedules and the Automation Platform add background automation, backed by a documented CLI reference and an OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs, concrete CI configuration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions)
